content.text: What does a probability of 0.7 mean? There are rival answers.

content.definition: Probability is how often something happens over many trials.
Probability is how strongly a reasonable person should believe something, given the evidence.

examples.title: Frequency
lines: A coin lands heads 4,998 times in 10,000 flips.
examples.conclusion: Its probability of heads is about 0.5.
examples.note: On this view the probability is the long run rate.

examples.title: A single event
lines: What is the chance this one surgery succeeds?
examples.note: One event has no long run of trials. The subjective view treats its chance as a degree of belief.

question.prompt: On the frequency view, what does 'a 0.7 chance of rain tomorrow' mean?
options: I am 70% sure it will rain
On days like this one, it rains about 70% of the time
70% of the sky will have rain
The forecast is right 70% of the time
question.hint: The frequency view counts how often something happens.
question.explanation: The frequency view reads probability as a long run rate: in conditions like these, it rains about 70% of the time.
